title: PanDWM: Panoramic 4D Driving World Models
control_family: layout, box, map or BEV conditioning

output_modality.value: One 360 degree panoramic surround-view video, lifted by a feed-forward decoder into 3D Gaussians and 4D scenes for novel-view rendering.

control_signal.value: Class-coloured 3D box wireframes and HD-map outlines stitched into the panorama, short text prompt, 3 panoramic history frames, and virtual-camera ray maps.

control_mechanism.value: Box and map images enter through image-adapter residuals in the first six blocks; CLIP and T5 text via SD3 joint attention; Fourier ray maps added to cross-view and temporal blocks.

base_model.value: SD3 diffusion transformer with UniMLVG cross-view and temporal extensions, SD3.5 VAE; four-step causal student distilled from a causal teacher; Gaussian decoder using Depth Anything 3 ranges.

datasets.value: nuScenes: 700 training scenes; 150 validation scenes with Val-150, Test-S, Test-L and Dev-78 subsets.

metrics.value: FID, I3D-based FVD-1 and FVD-2, flicker and sharpness ratios; object recall (Faster R-CNN) and road IoU (Mask2Former) for controllability; NFE, time per frame; AbsRel depth.

controllability_evidence.value: Controllability is scored by object recall and road IoU, but the packet gives no values. Fidelity on Val-150: FID 10.09 and FVD-1 37.4.

closed_loop.value: No policy loop stated in packet; autoregressive long rollouts up to 19.5 s on nuScenes validation scenes.

stated_limitations.value: Each window sees only the last three generated frames, Test-L FVD grows from 86.6 to 126.6; 4D completion covers only static content, leaving moving objects' unseen parts empty.

notes: Controllability results not visible in packet. Packet mentions Gaussian novel-view rendering with moved viewpoints, which is the camera-control aspect.
